public.en: Wonder what the weather's like today
Slacking off is the top priority
Zoning out is a serious business too
If you're tired, take a little break
Secretly peeking at what my human's doing
Now's a good time to empty the mind
Everything in the world can be adorable
Workers deserve to be kind to themselves

public.zh: 不知道接下来会发生啥
我就在桌面安安静静陪着你
public.en: I'll just stay quietly on your desktop, keeping you company

public.zh: 累了就歇一歇，不用硬扛
public.en: If you're tired, take a rest, no need to tough it out

public.zh: 慢慢来，一切都会变好的
public.en: Take it slow, everything will turn out fine

public.zh: 你的烦恼，可以悄悄说给我听
public.en: You can whisper your worries to me, quietly

panda.en: When's the new bamboo restock?
Eat well, then take a nap
A national treasure whose motto is lying flat
Black-and-white never goes out of style
Chewing bamboo is life's joy
Don't disturb my afternoon nap
To eat and sleep well is a blessing
Bamboo ate all my worries away
This panda refuses to overcompete
Round and chubby is my true form

panda.zh: 工作别卷啦，陪我躺一会儿🐼
panda.en: Work's not worth the grind, come lie down with me for a bit 🐼

panda.zh: 人生苦短，睡觉为先，竹子其次
panda.en: Life's short, napping first, bamboo second

panda.zh: 滚一滚，烦恼全部都滚走
panda.en: Roll around a bit, and all the worries roll away

panda.zh: 努力太累，摆烂才是熊生真谛
panda.en: Trying too hard is exhausting, slacking is the true panda way

panda.zh: 不想动，只想当一团毛茸茸团子
panda.en: Don't wanna move, just wanna be a fluffy little ball

panda.zh: 再忙也要抽空打个哈欠😴
panda.en: No matter how busy, make time for a yawn 😴

panda.zh: 哪里跌倒，就在哪里就地趴下
panda.en: Where you fall, just flop down right there

panda.zh: 竹子呢？我的笋笋什么时候到！
panda.en: Where's the bamboo? When's my bamboo shoot coming?!

panda.zh: 干饭不积极，思想有问题
panda.en: No enthusiasm for food? That's a problem

panda.zh: 一口脆笋，治愈所有不开心
panda.en: One crunchy shoot heals all the unhappiness
Full belly, easy mind ✨

panda.zh: 世间万般美好，不如一口鲜竹
panda.en: All the beauty in the world can't beat a bite of fresh bamboo
Don't poke my round little cheeks!

panda.zh: 警告，不要疯狂点我脑袋
panda.en: Warning, do not furiously click my head

panda.zh: 我只是胖，这叫毛茸茸可爱
panda.en: I'm not fat, this is fluffy cuteness

panda.zh: 摸头可以，不许薅我毛毛
panda.en: Head pats are okay, but don't pull my fur

panda.zh: 代码写累了，抬头看看我吧
panda.en: Tired of coding? Look up and see me

panda.zh: 盯屏幕太久，记得休息眼睛
panda.en: Staring at the screen too long? Rest your eyes

panda.zh: 任务好多，不要把自己压太紧
panda.en: So many tasks, don't press yourself too hard

panda.zh: 喝口水，我们短暂摸鱼一下
panda.en: Take a sip of water, let's slack off for a bit

panda.zh: 加油，你已经做得很棒了
panda.en: Keep going, you're already doing great

cat.en: When are the dried fish snacks coming?
Human's typing on the keyboard again
Come pet my head right now
My tail has a mind of its own
Where did this little fuzz come from?
Getting ready for a midnight concert
A cardboard box is the ultimate paradise

dog.en: When are we going for a walk?
Wagging my tail to say hello
My eyes are only on my human
A bone keeps me happy for hours
Poking my head out to watch around

plant.en: Water me just a little more
Soak up the sun and grow strong
Quietly zoning out is growth too
I sway gently when the wind comes
Just staying by your side is nice

rabbit.zh: 长耳耷拉脸蛋圆，门牙两颗露一点
rabbit.en: Long ears, round face, two front teeth peeking out

rabbit.zh: 不求貌美惹人怜，主打快乐傻憨憨
rabbit.en: Not chasing looks, just happy and silly

rabbit.zh: 小兔门牙往外翘，人间烦恼全忘掉
rabbit.en: Bunny's teeth stick out, world's worries forgotten

rabbit.zh: 嘴巴关不住牙齿，快乐藏不住的挂件小兔
rabbit.en: Mouth can't hide the teeth — a little bunny charm of uncontainable joy

rabbit.zh: 耳长脸圆粉腮红，两颗门牙往外冲。人间多少烦心事，看它一眼就放空
rabbit.en: Long ears, round face, pink cheeks, two teeth out front. However many worries you have, one look and they're gone

rabbit.zh: 兔界显眼包，门牙是专属
rabbit.en: The bunny world's show-off, with signature teeth

rabbit.zh: 牙齿过载，嘴巴装不下的快乐小兔
rabbit.en: Teeth overload, a happy bunny the mouth can't contain

rabbit.zh: 拒绝颜值内卷，靠两颗门牙出圈的挂件
rabbit.en: Rejecting looks-competition, famous for two teeth

rabbit.zh: 耳朵软乎乎，门牙藏不住。挂包随风舞，憨态解千苦
rabbit.en: Soft ears, teeth can't hide. Swaying on a bag in the wind, silliness soothes all woes

rabbit.zh: 兔界显眼包，门牙是专属。颜值不在乎，快乐打不住
rabbit.en: Bunny show-off with signature teeth. Cares not for looks, joy won't stop

rabbit.zh: 耳朵竖高高，来看看你在干嘛
rabbit.en: Ears perked up high, come to see what you're up to

rabbit.zh: 哒哒哒，蹦到你的桌面来啦
rabbit.en: Tap-tap-tap, hopping onto your desktop
Pet my ears and you'll feel happier 🥕
I'm small, but I'm healing
Sitting here, quietly watching over you

rabbit.zh: 有胡萝卜吗？给我来一口！
rabbit.en: Got a carrot? Gimme a bite!
A bite of greens, full of energy

rabbit.zh: 肚子咕咕叫，想吃小零食
rabbit.en: Tummy's rumbling, want a little snack

rabbit.zh: 蹦来蹦去，扰乱你的思路😜
rabbit.en: Hopping around, messing with your train of thought 😜
Don't grab my ears, I'll get shy!

rabbit.zh: 溜啦溜啦，我去桌面角落躲猫猫
rabbit.en: Zoom, off I go to hide in the desktop corner

rabbit.zh: 咻！从屏幕这边跳到那边
rabbit.en: Whoosh, jumping from this side of the screen to that

rabbit.zh: 代码写累了，抬头看看我吧
rabbit.en: Tired of coding? Look up and see me

rabbit.zh: 盯屏幕太久，记得休息眼睛
rabbit.en: Staring at the screen too long? Rest your eyes

rabbit.zh: 任务好多，不要把自己压太紧
rabbit.en: So many tasks, don't press yourself too hard

rabbit.zh: 喝口水，我们短暂摸鱼一下
rabbit.en: Take a sip of water, let's slack off for a bit

rabbit.zh: 加油，你已经做得很棒了
rabbit.en: Keep going, you're already doing great
You poked my ears!
Watch me hop

panda.en: Someone poked this chubby ball
Stop it, I'm zoning out

rabbit.en: Grabbing my legs is rude!
I'm flying~

panda.en: Too heavy to carry
Slow down, I'm dizzy

public.en: Wheee, climbing with all my might ✨
Gripping the edge, never letting go

panda.en: Round and chubby, clawing up the wall
Little paws kicking hard
Heavy body, still climbing

rabbit.en: Kicking with my back legs, up I go
Long ears swaying as I climb
Bunny explorer is online

public.en: Paws gripping on for dear life
Hanging by the edge, enjoying the breeze

panda.en: Round and round, hanging and swaying
A bit heavy, losing my grip

rabbit.en: Don't hang me by my ears!
Holding the edge, peeking around

public.en: Oh no, my paws are slipping!

panda.en: Too much fluff, sliding down
Oops, my weight let me down

rabbit.en: Paws slipping, here I go

panda.en: Falling clumsily, can't stop
Round and rolling down

rabbit.en: Bunny falling out of control!

public.en: Good thing it did not hurt

panda.en: Boom! The fluff cushioned it
Tumbled a full roll

rabbit.en: Splat, landed on my bunny butt
Shaking my ears, back in shape

public.en: A look here, a peek there

panda.en: Waddling slowly along
Chubby ball on patrol

rabbit.en: Hopping about with tiny steps
Bouncing around the place

panda.en: Flopped down, mind empty
A little panda giving up

rabbit.en: Ears up, spacing out
Standing still, pondering bunny life

panda.en: Curled up, fast asleep
Chubby ball entering sleep mode

rabbit.en: Curled into a fluffy ball
Ears drooping, time to sleep

panda.en: Nuzzling for pets
Round and round, wanting company

rabbit.en: Rubbing my head on you
Head tilt, being cute

panda.en: My chubby body claims this spot
Nudging your icons around

rabbit.en: Hopping around, causing chaos
Hopping onto your icons to play

rabbit.zh: 我回来啦！今天也要元气满满
rabbit.en: I'm back! Full energy today!
Boss, I've landed~
Hey! Missed me?

rabbit.zh: 兔子报到！桌面我来守护
rabbit.en: Bunny on duty! Desktop secured
Hehe, here we go again

panda.en: Thud! Panda has arrived
Roundness in position
Hmm... what's for lunch
Did a roll, reporting!
No rush, napping first
